name: Enterprise Cloud Print
description: Windows MDM settings in the Enterprise Cloud Print category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: Cloud Print OAuth Authority (User)
properties.description: Authentication endpoint for acquiring OAuth tokens

properties.name: Cloud Print OAuth Client Id (User)
properties.description: A GUID identifying the client application authorized to retrieve OAuth tokens from the OAuthAuthority

properties.name: Cloud Print Resource Id (User)
properties.description: Resource URI for which access is being requested by the Enterprise Cloud Print client during OAuth authentication

properties.name: Cloud Printer Discovery End Point (User)
properties.description: This policy provisions per-user discovery end point to discover cloud printers

properties.name: Mopria Discovery Resource Id (User)
properties.description: Resource URI for which access is being requested by the Mopria discovery client during OAuth authentication
